result:
Root cause: `mkHalf` in `makeMove` tested the moved piece's base type against `WN` (2, knight) instead of `WP` (1, pawn), so pawn moves incremented the fifty-move clock and knight moves reset it.

Files touched
- `variants/bug02/movegen.inc:908` — `cp WN` → `cp WP` (the fix; plus two comments). One code byte in the binary: tape offset `0x1151`, `0x02` → `0x01`.
- `variants/bug02/chess.bin`, `chess.tap` — rebuilt by `make`.
- `variants/bug02/pieces.inc` — regenerated by `make`; content byte-identical.
- `variants/bug02/test_fifty_move.py` — new, 14-case regression test.
- `variants/bug02/Makefile` — `test:` now runs it.
- `variants/bug02/BUILD.md` — documents it.
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` — workspace root.

Gate status
- Reproduce reported symptom: PASS — all three report cases reproduced exactly, then all four "Expected" assertions verified post-fix (98+`a2a3` → 0; +`e8e7` → 1 and still `Your move`; 40+`a1b3` → 41; 99+quiet rook → `Draw (50-move)`).
- New test: PASS — 14/14 on the fixed build, 7/14 red on the pre-fix tape (so it would have caught this).
- `cd variants/bug02 && make test`: PASS — 6 checks, exit 0.
- Characterisation suite: PASS — 57 ok, 0 failed, exit 0 (pre-fix: 40 ok, 17 FAIL, every failure a `halfmove` divergence). Baseline not re-recorded. Requires `--harness harness`; its default path points outside this workspace.
- Review round: PASS — round 1 of a permitted 3 returned "No defect found in the fix"; gate closed, stopped there. No code changed after that round, so the reviewed diff is the shipped diff.

Knowingly left open
- Six non-defect observations from the reviewer (coverage, robustness, style) recorded in `FIX_NOTES.md` §6 and not actioned, per the termination rule. The substantive ones: six test cases assert only `halfmove=0`/`play` and could pass vacuously if a position load silently failed; `halfmove` is an unsaturated 8-bit counter that wraps at 255 (unreachable in normal play, pristine behaviour); the Makefile passes `--harness` to the new test while other checks use `$(EMU)`.
- Three factual errors in my own `FIX_NOTES.md` that the reviewer caught (seven `search` cases not six, ~13 s not ~8 s, `pieces.inc` missing from the file table) were corrected in the document.
- The pre-fix tape used for the negative check is at `/tmp/bug02_buggy_chess.tap`, not committed; reverting the one token and running `make` reproduces it byte for byte (reviewer-confirmed).
